integrity.finite_verification: Exact coefficientwise brute enumeration for all chain partitions through six points, independent decorated matching tests, and uniform polynomial EGF tests.
integrity.literature_priority: Self-review with explicit residual priority risk.
integrity.proof_basis: Direct prefix-to-suffix parametrization, cycle characterization, permutation signed-cancellation identity and labeled exponential formula.

scientific_limitations: The fixed partial injection must be nilpotent, with no cycle components.
The counts are of labeled elements rather than conjugacy classes; centralizer multiplication is not classified.
An equivalent derived enumerator may be implicit in prior centralizer literature; the 2020 structural paper was inaccessible in full.
title: A cycle-cancellation sieve for nilpotent centralizers in symmetric inverse monoids
